lead: A test helper that names a file in `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR` after its *input* races the other tests that ask for the same input.
body: Tests run in parallel, so a reader catching another thread's `fs::write` half-done sees a truncated document: intermittently, and never under `cargo test -- <one test name>`. Run the *whole* binary on the stashed tree; the fix is a per-call counter in the name (`crates/nvs-cli/tests/openapi.rs`'s `document`).
